observation.command:
cd /workspace/example.org
D=web/profiles/contrib/openculturas-distribution
echo "=== released distribution version ==="; grep -m1 "version:" $D/profile/openculturas.info.yml 2>/dev/null
echo "=== released openstreetmap deps ==="; awk '/^dependencies:/{f=1;next} /^[a-z_]+:/{if(f)exit} f' $D/profile/modules/custom/openculturas_openstreetmap/openculturas_openstreetmap.info.yml 2>/dev/null
echo "=== example.org config dirs ==="; ls config/; ls config/sync 2>/dev/null | head -3; echo "sync count: $(ls config/sync 2>/dev/null | wc -l)"
echo "=== does example.org have its own composer.lock distribution version ==="; grep -n -A2 '"openculturas/openculturas-distribution"' composer.json
